chapters.title: Chapter 239: Progress, Spreading Rumors
paragraphs: 24 days have passed since Kent started practicing the sword mind technique using the 10,002 swordplays now imbued inside the sword of enlightenment.
He had seen tremendous changes, and it was all thanks to his past memories as Jest.
He had already mastered 340 out of the 10,002, which has changed everything about him. In fact, his current state is different from that of 24 days ago.
First, Jest was someone who started by swinging his sword like any novice swordsman. He started out like a rat and managed to rise to the level of a dog.
This means he had accumulated enough experience that Kent was now learning from. That was why he received the memories in the first place.
However, the past 24 days weren’t about him learning the 10,002 swordplays.
No.
He was after something else; it was all about the experience and mastery down to the root. In a way, he went back to the novice level and filled all the gaps he had in his understanding of the sword.
He corrected some mistakes he made, and from the sword knowledge he has and the ones now in his mind, he was able to make great strides.
Now, he is firm and solid in the belief that if he were to face the new and improved Saintess, he could still hold his own for a few hours before losing.
He wasn’t about to get cocky. The Saintess has become a monster.
Right now, he was determined to defeat her in combat at full strength, so he wasn’t about to think he could take her on in his current state.
But that doesn’t mean he hasn’t become stronger. It’s quite the opposite, actually. Just 27 years of memory were enough to help him understand quite a lot.
He saw Jest lose a couple of times, so he knew from experience there were just some powers he wouldn’t be able to overcome.
But that was if it was all about the sword.
And now, he is all about the sword.
The next memory will be when he starts to build a path the first sword path. For some reason, he wanted to learn more before that day.
Something keeps telling him that being ahead now will tremendously affect him in all the right ways as he ascends to the Saint Sword stage.

So he was now deep in his meditation, which made his sword intent and aura grow stronger by the day. If anyone who hadn’t reached the Sword Saint stage were to come within 30 meters of him, they would be cut into countless pieces.
Just the Sword Qi alone has grown to a terrifying stage.
And the strange part—if it were to be measured, he would still be at the 5th level of the enhanced sword qi Stage. In a way, his sword intent and Qi are growing, but their ranks are not increasing.
Now, that is something one must fear.
All swordsmen can, in a way, gauge the grade of intent and Qi in their opponents. This helps them know how much effort they need to put into their attacks and defence.

But what if the person is like Kent, whose level 5 Enhanced intent should be something akin to a 7/9 intent? That is where the understanding of the sword comes into play, and now, Jest has come back to help him.
He is growing, and the universe is watching...
The tale started when the universe formed.
That is called the Awakening.
But there will be destruction, and that will be the end. It was said that the known universe and the Annihilation universe would battle.
Obviously, the one who lost the battle would be annihilated.
Kent was now chosen as the favoured son of the universe. This means he was the one the universe would count on. That also means he was someone favored by the Universe.
This means the Dao of the sword and all other Dao favor him.
But the path he must traverse wouldn’t be simple—Kent was bound to rise, but the process wouldn’t exactly be a walk in the park.
Meanwhile, on the outside, things are not looking good for the Miller and Malric families. News somehow found its way out, making everyone aware of the sudden death of two noble heirs.
This came as a shock to everyone. They just couldn’t understand why two heirs were suddenly killed. It was as if the events that started in Caprath City had now reached this family.
Everything turned chaotic since the two families declared they would stop at nothing to catch the perpetrators of this attack.
But that wasn’t the most pressing matter. The most harrowing situation was the news circulating that a mere Inner Disciple of the Divine Palace Sect had threatened the Wicked Poison Witch.
Somehow, news found its way out there. Now, everyone began to wonder just who was bold enough to threaten a whole Pill Saint.
Obviously, those trying to suck up to the Pill Saint started storming the entrance to the sect.
Well, they tried at first, but after the Sword Gate Master severed a few heads, they retreated and camped out 2 km from the main gate.
Some also started painting the sect in a bad light, saying all kinds of things about them. They all want to curry favor with the Pill Saint.
However, while the blockheads were doing the blockheaded things, some started asking logical and sound questions.
"If this was true, why is the Divine Palace Sect still standing?"
They all know what the Wicked Poison Witch is capable of. So, if what people were spreading about her being threatened by a mere Inner Disciple was true, then how the hell is the sect still standing?
Obviously, something doesn’t add up. The Wicked Poison witch isn’t that generous. She wouldn’t hesitate to poison the entire sect of she had to...
But as to what really happened, or even if this was indeed true, no one can prove it. There was no video evidence to back the claims, so they said they were all baseless accusations.
But that was to be assumed—for now.
Kent hadn’t come out yet. His master is currently cultivating inside the [Yin Pool]. The Spear Saintess also hasn’t returned yet.
So, in a way, things are now being handled by the now-energetic Gate Master, who just doesn’t know how to feel about Kent.
One time, Kent was causing all kinds of trouble, and all she could think of was only wanting to kill him for good.
The next, he was helping her calm her fatigue and gain energy that she never knew was possible, simply from drinking a bottle of wine Kent gave her.
He was like the cat who steals your meat but also guards your house against the mice. You just cannot kill him despite his troubles.
But then again, destiny has a funny way of playing ball.
Her sister was once a Night Rider, and now, she is being summoned to ride again. This means what she had been chasing for years is almost at hand.
What’s left is whether she can wholeheartedly trust Kent... to save her sister, who is slowly losing hope inside the cage the sect master placed her in many years ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Challenging the Sword Bridge
paragraphs: 72 days had passed since Kent entered seclusion, and so far, he had done only one thing: sit in the same spot, eyes closed, hands resting on his knees.
He was deep in meditation, focusing on understanding the sword path thoroughly before delving into his next set of memories.
This took him days, but he had finally managed to improve, drawing on the knowledge from his past as Jest.

Now, all he was doing was mastering the 10,002 sword plays, a task he had been dedicated to for quite some time. In fact, over the past weeks, the only thing that had changed about him was his energy.
He hadn’t even moved a finger...
His sword qi and intent had grown much more pronounced, and from the look of things, he had made significant progress.
At this point, even a swordsman with an Enhanced Sword aura at the 7/9 stage would struggle to maintain their composure in his presence.
His sword intent and sword aura were still at the Level 5 Enhanced stage, but they had grown to a level that could be measured at the 7th.
"Ha," Kent sighed as he opened his eyes after 72 days.
He stood up and retrieved his sword.
He held it in his hands for a few minutes and then sighed again. Slowly, he began to pull it from the sheath.
The sight was mesmerizing. His presence was already powerful, but the moment he started drawing the sword, his aura began to change.
The energy around him grew more refined and potent. The intent behind the sword qi was overwhelming.
In fact, "powerful" is an understatement. The intent was so intense that it could press down on anyone within his domain.
The further the sword emerged from the sheath, the more his presence intensified. It was as if all his energy had been stored within the sword’s sheath.
After fully drawing the sword, he sighed and then sheathed it again. The energy around him was just too overwhelming.
"Just 700 swordplays can be this effective. I wonder what I will become after mastering all 10,002 swordplays," Kent murmured.
He sighed once more, but a faint smile played on his lips as he gazed toward the long sword bridge.
’I wonder if I can challenge it,’ he thought, his expression determined. The sword bridge was one of the requirements he needed to fulfill to become a Sword Saint.
He would have to overcome all 13 obstacles and emerge victorious in each. It didn’t matter how many attempts it took; he had to conquer all 13 to achieve the title of Sword Saint.
Gaia had advised him against attempting it immediately after becoming a Sword Grandmaster. But now, he was different.
He wasn’t the same as before when he merely swung his sword without purpose. Now, he has the experience and focus to back up his every move.
He had now reached the stage where he could wield the sword with a purpose in mind. He has become a swordsman
"It wouldn’t hurt to try."
He moved, and soon, he was a few meters from the sword bridge. The colossal sword stretched far into the distance, its surface wide enough to accommodate hundreds of people standing side by side.
"This is just beautiful," Kent said. But the next second, he was atop the colossal sword, walking forward. After a few meters, a message appeared before his eyes.
⟪Welcome to the Sword Bridge. To pass, you must defeat the 13 swordsmen. Death is not permanent, but every death increases the difficulty of the 13 trials by one⟫
"Just great," Kent sighed, and then he took a step forward. He moved a couple of meters before coming to a halt. Something changed...
This time, someone appeared—a copy of himself, wearing a white tunic armor. His hair was short silver-white, and his sword was also white.
But he looked exactly like Kent, and Kent couldn’t help but smile slightly. He could already see what was coming.
The clone version of himself undoubtedly had the same abilities as him, but with a twist, and Kent knew exactly the danger he was in.
He moved forward, and just as he was 50 meters from the clone, he unleashed his sword intent and sword aura. The clone did the same, but instantly, Kent realized he was out of his league.
He quickly unsheathed his sword, and the clone mirrored his action, causing him to grit his teeth. The pressure is just too much.
Then he moved forward, and the two clashed, creating shockwaves.
Kent executed a series of attacks, but they were countered by the clone as effortlessly as they were launched, making Kent smile through it all.
’This trial won’t be easy at all.’
He said to himself, but his determination was not something he would hold back. He kept attacking and defending while he analyzed the battle.
Suddenly, the clone unleashed the [24 String Weaving Strike], and Kent was forced to move back.
The attack was perfect, and Kent, who knew that the perfect form of that skill had finally appeared, also unleashed the same technique in counter.
The two attacks connected, and powerful shockwaves exploded from the collision.
Akira and Gaia appeared inside the Sword Gate. They were watching from a distance, and from the smiles on their faces, it was evident they were happy about something.
Kent moved back and unleashed the same attack again, but the clone was a step ahead. It countered and unleashed a more powerful version of the skill [36 String Weaving Strike].
But Kent countered as well, and so the two began using all the different versions of the [String Weaving Strike] skills, each countering and canceling out the other’s attacks.
Kent was rather pleased with the battle, which had only been going on for the past 10 minutes.
But then he decided to up the game and unleashed a more dreadful attack.
"Rapid Slash!"
The last time he fought with the Saintess, he was able to unleash 100 sword arcs with just a single swing. Now, he unleashed 230, and the air was filled with the golden hue sword arcs.
A sword Grandmaster wouldn’t know how they died if this attack came for them. Even some Sword Saints would despair.
But not the clone.
When the attack was unleashed, the clone swung its sword. It was a casual swing, but Kent saw the difference between them.
It was also when he died.

chapters.title: Chapter 241: High Expectations
paragraphs: "Damn, death is not ideal at all."
Kent said, now sitting at the edge of the sword bridge. The clone was gone, and he died from the last attack.
"So the clone fights based on the level of skill I am using. But he is much better at using them than me." Kent wasn’t disappointed. This was an eye-opener.
He saw the nature of the trial and now knew what awaited him.

The clone did the same when he used the [24 String Weaving strike]. But as the swordsman, Kent saw the disparity between their two attacks. The strength and master behind the clone are much more powerful than his.
In fact, he was shocked when he saw just how effortlessly the clone unleashed the subsequent skills until they reached the [72 String Sovereign Strike].
The clone was what one could call the Perfect replica with excellent mastery.
But that wasn’t all. Though the clone attacks are based on the mastery level of Kent, it also has the true level Kent must be when using that skill.
That was what got him killed.
"450 sword arcs from just a single swing."
He unleashed 230 sword arcs that were not even refined, but the clone unleashed 450, which was the same [Rapid Slash] form of the Annihilation Sword technique.
They both used the [Annihilation Sword] technique, but there was a disparity between them, between heaven and earth.
"That is crazy. To think I was calling myself a genius just because I was able to unleash 230 Arcs at the same time."
A weak smile appeared on his lips.
"Then this means if I want to have a shot at killing this clone, I must master this technique to the same level as him and even understand it better than him."
"But is that even possible? I mean, from what I sensed, this clone is the perfect version of me. So, would I even be able to surpass him?"
"Then the only way to win this first trial is to kill him somehow using the [String Weaving Strike] skill. I can only think of that. But who is to say there are no other tricks up his sleeve?
"What if it can use the other skills I have even when I am not using them? Who is to say he wouldn’t go beyond the [Rapid Slash], and who is to say it wouldn’t use some skills I don’t have?"
[You would have to find that one out yourself Master.]
Gaia replied, and Kent knew his thinking was spot on. What he had learned so far was just the smallest there was to know about the trial.
"Tell me everything, Gaia," He asked, and the Cosmic Loli smiled teasingly.

[The clone is you but also not you. The clone is you in the sense that it’s the perfect Sword Grandmaster version of you, but it’s not you in the sense that the true essence of the Genesis Sword Path is now within him.

This means you will be fighting against a perfect version of yourself who has all your skills and can use them randomly, as well as a perfect version of the true Genesis Sword Path at the Grandmaster stage.]
"Then I am screwed," Kent said with a weak smile.
[In a way, yes. The trial only grows more harrowing as you progress. But you are also to be applauded for surviving against the clone for 13 whole minutes. I expected you to die within 40 seconds.]
"You know, Gaia, Akira is my favorite," Kent said, but Akira just blushed and hid her face behind Gaia.
"What was her estimate?" Kent knew the two assistants, who should be rooting for him, were actually placing universal bets on how long he would last.
[23 seconds]
Gaia replied, and Kent could only smile. But they weren’t wrong. He indeed wasn’t meant to survive that long. This could only mean one thing: Kent is now on a different level.
To fight against a perfect version of yourself and a perfect version of the path you are walking, and last that long, was not something to be taken lightly.
"What do I need to do?"

[The master should train more. Master the 10,002 swordplays. Also, engage in more battles. I have a battle doll that can take the same shape and form as you. In a way, it’s my own version of the perfect replica.
You can buy it and train with it. I will be regulating it mid-battle so that the longer you fight with it, the more mastery and closer you will get to the perfect clone.
Though the sword bridge would have been ideal for this. Anytime you die, the difficulty of the trial increases, so you have to make do with this.

Also, you can train more with your master and her sister. They are each suited to bring out your potential. Of course, just another memory of your past, and you will be able to handle the first level of the sword bridge...
And then there is Enlightenment. You can focus on that, and if you manage to gain one enlightenment, that will also push you a step closer to reaching the perfect you.]
"Thanks, Gaia. This is indeed the best way for me to grow. I will train much more and go on more missions. This way, I will be able to grow faster."
Kent stood up and sheathed his sword. The battle just now showed him what he could become, and for that, he was determined to train.
"Alina is waking up," Kent said, sensing her inside the Harem Tower.
She had been asleep for 72 days already. That is a long time, but she needed it, considering she had wanted only one thing for 20 years and finally got it. Now, she is free from all her trauma.
So when she passed out, she drifted into a sleep that washed away all forms of trauma she had been through...
[Your master is now in the real world, and the Spear Saintess has also come out of her seclusion and is looking for you.]
Gaia said with a smile.
"What is that smile for?" Kent asked.
[You will find out soon enough. Oh, Uncle Drew and the beautiful sister are also back and are now surveying the sect for reasons I or Akira don’t know.]
"Tsk... I will be going now, and thanks for keeping an eye out on this for me."

chapters.title: Chapter 242: What to do next...
paragraphs: Kent teleported, and the next second, he was inside the Harem Tower.
He moved again, and suddenly, he was in front of the glass building housing the Pleasure Bed. He entered, and there on the bed, staring all around her, was Alina, who had just woken from her sleep.
"Took you long enough," Kent said, bringing her attention to him.
The room she was in wasn’t something she had ever seen before, nor had she slept on such a quality bed before. In fact, she didn’t even know if a bed like this existed in this world.
"Where am I?" she asked, still looking around.
"You’re inside your new home. This is where I and all my women come to spend time together. You are now my woman, so you have access to all of this."
Alina gave him a "Are you serious?" expression, to which Kent just smiled and nodded.
"You can already feel you’re connected to this place somehow. That’s because I made it so you would feel connected, making you something akin to an owner."
Alina was in disbelief.
She had just woken up, and now, she was being forced to accept something she never knew possible.
"Is this for real?" She asked.

"Very real. This is not a dream," Kent said, taking her hand. "You have gotten your revenge and are now free of the past pains and trauma. You are now free of that pain you have been in for all those years."
"Thank you for everything, Kent. I, indeed, am free. I will just need a couple of days to come to terms with this and everything else."
"You have all the time in the world while inside this place. The time here runs differently from the time outside," Kent said.
"Then I will have to spend some alone time here for a couple of days. I won’t be going anywhere before the auction, and I don’t expect anyone to, either."

"Then stay here and have this whole place to yourself. I also have some things to do in the real world, so spending a couple of months here will be good for you," Kent said. Alina nodded, but her expression changed, so she asked:
"How long exactly is the time here compared to the outside?"

"24 days here is a day outside. This means an hour outside is a day in here. And don’t worry, you won’t age while inside here. In other words, time doesn’t affect you in here like it does on the outside."
"Really?"

"Really. This place is the best, so you have all the time you will need. It has a very lush garden with all kinds of fruit inside. In fact, let’s take a quick stroll through this place before I leave."
The two left to explore the harem tower. Kent led her to the Love Garden, where they spent some time wandering through the lush garden filled with some of the best fruits out there.
Some of those fruits are no ordinary ones, and Alina, who is a manager at an auction house, could tell their value just by looking at them.
In fact, if she were to take a few back, it would create a cataclysmic event in the upcoming auctions.

"You are now my woman, so don’t worry about anything. Just get your affairs in order and let me know when you are ready to begin walking the path of a Formation Expert, like how you wanted to many years ago,"
Kent said, holding her hand as they moved through the Love Garden.

"Not only do you have a goddess as your wife, but you also have this place as your domain. This makes me wonder what would have become of me had I not gathered the courage to approach you," Alina said, covering her face.
Kent just smiled. The rest of his ladies had yet to reach out to her, so he wouldn’t say anything now. When he goes back to the outside world, Selene, Unity, Lilian, and Elsa will come to her.
They are the best gals to help her through her transition, so he would allow them to handle that.

"You didn’t have to do much. From the moment I saw that ass, I knew it was only a matter of time till I sank my fingers in and gave them a massage while I bounced them up and down on my lap," Kent said, massaging them.
This caused Alina to blush deeply.
They appeared before the Yin Pool a few minutes after leaving the Love Garden.
"This is where all my ladies cultivate. It will also be where you will cultivate from now onwards. It will enrich your yin qi and enhance your beauty whenever you cultivate inside."
Alina was impressed and happy to have finally walked into a life she could live for herself instead of worrying about past traumas.
After leaving the Yin Pool, they made their way back to the large bed, where they got naked and started a marathon that lasted for four hours.
"I will be leaving now. My women, who are now your sisters, will come to visit soon," Kent said to her. "Have fun."
Alina nodded, and Kent left, returning to the real world, where a lot was waiting for him to handle. When he appeared, he saw his master seated on the bed, cultivating.
Kent scanned her body, and from the aura around her, he could tell she was now at the stage she had wanted to be for years.
Her spirit root has been upgraded to the Dark Gold Grade, so now, her talent in cultivation has also increased tremendously.
Though she will need a few months to get used to this change, Saintess Selene is a genius, so she was able to get acquainted with some of these changes the moment her spirit root was upgraded...
Kent sat down and began staring at her while she cultivated. Two hours later, she opened her eyes, meeting Kent’s.
"I could stare at you all day and never get tired," Kent said, making his master blush. "Congratulations on your breakthrough."
She is now a Level 2 Root Great Sage.
"Thank you. Now, can we have sex so I can increase your rank? I only came out for that. I will have to meet my new sister and spend some time with her."
Kent smiled, hearing her offer. "If I said no to that, I want you to tie me upside down and give me some beatings."
He lunged at her, and soon, the sound of moaning filled the house. It went on for hours until Kent rose two levels, becoming a Level 4 Root Saint.

chapters.title: Chapter 243: The Hidden Night Rider, Sect Quest
paragraphs: After a couple of rounds with Selene, she returned to the Tower, where she and the rest of Kent’s ladies would spend weeks with Alina, getting to know each other.
Kent, on the other hand, was now alone in the mini-mansion.
In the coming days, he might enter the sword garden, according to his master. But that was in the coming days.
He wanted to become very strong, so he would be sparring with the Spear Saintess, who had become a monster after her last enlightenment.
His master would also be his sparring partner, but he would first take her to start walking the path meant for her. This was his next big reward for her.
He also planned to see if he could strengthen his relationship with the gate master. This way, he would even have another powerful swordsman to train with.
But first, he had to handle something.
Uncle Drew and Saden are back from their mission, and according to Gaia, they are secretly surveying the sect as if they are looking for something.
He wants to find out what they are looking for and, if possible, help them find it.
So he waited until evening since he knew they wouldn’t risk entering the sect during the day. They are night riders, so the night is for them.
"You can come out now," Kent called out just as the moon appeared.
A second later, two figures clad in dark, hooded clothes emerged from the darkness, their eyes glowing green.
"Congratulations on your mission," Kent said to them, then turned to Saden. "I hope your revenge was as you expected it."
Saden turned to her human form and nodded. Of course, Kent could tell something was wrong, but he didn’t ask immediately.
He turned to Uncle Drew, who was now also in his human form.
"Since you are here, I presume you want something... Care to share what that is?" he asked.
"I believe the next Night Rider is in this sect, so we came to look for her. But after surveying the sect, we couldn’t find anything," Uncle Drew said, making Kent raise an eyebrow.
"A ’her,’ and she’s a potential Night Rider? If you don’t mind me asking, how did you know that?" Kent inquired. For now, he simply didn’t understand how Uncle Drew did it.

When he made him a Night Rider back when he was teetering between life and death, Kent had never asked for details or sought answers. Now, however, he wanted to know just how Uncle Drew identified the Night Riders.

"I am the captain of the Night Riders, so I have the eyes to see and know my fellow Riders. You are my master, so you should also have that ability. But for it to manifest, you must first undergo the Trial of the Night, which you are not ready for just yet.
"Basically, I can sense and know the location of the next Night Rider. When it was time for their awakening, I could sense and go to them," Uncle Drew said thoughtfully.

"I sensed Saden when I left Caprath City back then, and a few weeks after that, I sensed Eryndor. Now, I am sensing a new member inside this sect, but I am not getting their true location for some reason.

"But I know they are inside this sect, and I intend to find out, considering she might be dying as we speak. I can sense it; I don’t know the direction. Something evil is preventing me," Uncle Drew explained.
Kent nodded and processed what he had just heard. In a way, it all made sense. But he also wanted to know how all of this was possible. Of course, his curiosity would have to be put aside for now.

"This is really interesting. I also sensed something evil inside this sect when I walked in for the first time. Of course, I brushed it aside, considering I am also evil. But now that you mention it, it seems an evil presence does exist in this sect.
"But the question is, who or where is this evil coming from?"

"Indeed. I tried to get a general direction of this evil intent, but nothing worked. I believe someone or some people are walking the path of evil, which is why I can’t sense her," Uncle Drew replied.
Kent sighed.

"That is rather unfortunate. But if the next Night Rider is inside this sect and someone or some people are preventing her from being seen, then it means the force at play is not one to be underestimated."
"Indeed. But I must find her before it’s too late. If a rider is sensed but not found and dies, it affects the whole legion. So I have to find her no matter what and help her awaken."
Kent didn’t say anything. He just sat there thinking. Since Gaia said nothing, it means she wasn’t even about to say anything, regardless of what she knew.
But that doesn’t mean she wouldn’t help. She already said spoon-feeding him would be bad, but using quests to spoon-feed him isn’t bad at all. At least he will put in the effort.
So Kent sighed in his heart, and for the first time since he was given the Universe Quest Pool, he made a wish for a quest.
’Universe Quest Pool, help me find the trapped Night Rider.’ That was all he thought, but the next second, the quest appeared, and it was a big one.
⟪Universe Quest Pool Activated: You have received your first wished quest. All rewards will be doubled⟫
⟪Quest Name: Clash With Evil⟫
⟪Quest Type: Sect Quest - 1/3 (Mini Chain Quest)⟫
⟪Quest Difficulty: Very Dangerous⟫
⟪Descriptions:⟫
-> The next Night Rider is identified as being inside this sect. But for some reasons unknown, her presence has been hidden.
-> The universe suspected something sinister was at work inside the Divine Palace Sect. This is also why when the Master of the Quest Pool calls, the universe has to listen.
⟦First Quest: Find out her Lineage⟧
-> For the first quest, carefully look for Nara Ly Kasti’s identity. Use all your smart to learn more about her.
-> Once her identity has been discovered, the next quest will appear.
⟪Rewards:⟫
→ Battle Space Domain x2
→ The Lost Undead Schematic (Creator Necromancer) x2
→ 1,000,000 Tower Points x2
Kent sighs and turns to his two Night Riders...

"I sensed Saden when I left Caprath City back then, and a few weeks after that, I sensed Eryndor.
Now, I am sensing a new member inside this sect, but I am not getting their true location for some reason.
"But I know they are inside this sect, and I intend to find out, considering she might be dying as we speak.
I can sense it; I don’t know the direction.
Something evil is preventing me," Uncle Drew explained.
Kent nodded and processed what he had just heard.
In a way, it all made sense.
But he also wanted to know how all of this was possible.
Of course, his curiosity would have to be put aside for now.
"This is really interesting.
I also sensed something evil inside this sect when I walked in for the first time.
Of course, I brushed it aside, considering I am also evil.
But now that you mention it, it seems an evil presence does exist in this sect.
"But the question is, who or where is this evil coming from?"
"Indeed.
I tried to get a general direction of this evil intent, but nothing worked.
I believe someone or some people are walking the path of evil, which is why I can’t sense her," Uncle Drew replied.
Kent sighed.
"That is rather unfortunate.
But if the next Night Rider is inside this sect and someone or some people are preventing her from being seen, then it means the force at play is not one to be underestimated."
"Indeed.
But I must find her before it’s too late.
If a rider is sensed but not found and dies, it affects the whole legion.
So I have to find her no matter what and help her awaken."
Kent didn’t say anything.
He just sat there thinking.
Since Gaia said nothing, it means she wasn’t even about to say anything, regardless of what she knew.
But that doesn’t mean she wouldn’t help.
She already said spoon-feeding him would be bad, but using quests to spoon-feed him isn’t bad at all.
At least he will put in the effort.
So Kent sighed in his heart, and for the first time since he was given the Universe Quest Pool, he made a wish for a quest.
’Universe Quest Pool, help me find the trapped Night Rider.’ That was all he thought, but the next second, the quest appeared, and it was a big one.
⟪Universe Quest Pool Activated: You have received your first wished quest.
All rewards will be doubled⟫
⟪Quest Name: Clash With Evil⟫
⟪Quest Type: Sect Quest - 1/3 (Mini Chain Quest)⟫
⟪Quest Difficulty: Very Dangerous⟫
⟪Descriptions:⟫
-> The next Night Rider is identified as being inside this sect.
But for some reasons unknown, her presence has been hidden.
-> The universe suspected something sinister was at work inside the Divine Palace Sect.
This is also why when the Master of the Quest Pool calls, the universe has to listen.
⟦First Quest: Find out her Lineage⟧
-> For the first quest, carefully look for Nara Ly Kasti’s identity.
Use all your smart to learn more about her.
-> Once her identity has been discovered, the next quest will appear.
⟪Rewards:⟫
→ Battle Space Domain x2
→ The Lost Undead Schematic (Creator Necromancer) x2
→ 1,000,000 Tower Points x2
Kent sighs and turns to his two Night Riders...

chapters.title: Chapter 244: Saden’s Mission
paragraphs: Kent looked at the two Night Riders before him and smiled.

"I have a way to find where the next Night Rider is. However, it will be dangerous, and I would have to do it alone for now. But I promise I will find her, and then we all can rescue her, assuming she is in danger."
Kent wasn’t about to assume the Night Rider was the one in danger or that she was the evil they were sensing. Anything is possible, so he wasn’t going to put all his cards on the table for now.
"Thank you, young master," Uncle Drew said with a heavy sigh.
"You don’t have to worry about that. Since your teammate is probably in danger, I can only do this much and hope it works out in the end."

Kent turned to Saden. "You have something on your mind. Come on, say it; we are all family here." To some extent, Kent could sense the emotions of those connected to him, so he knew Saden wasn’t right.
"I need your permission to go after the Malric Noble Family. They nearly made me kill my own sister, and from what I discovered, they are into the slave business."
Kent’s expression changed when he heard the word *slave*.
In fact, he had always been like that. It was that word that triggered him back in the Makosa prison when the lady from the Dark Devil Church threatened him.
In fact, it was now that he started to understand where that anger came from.

It was because of his life as Jest that made him hate slavery to that extent. Even billions of years later, the thought of becoming someone’s slave pissed him off. In fact, now, merely hearing the word *slave* pissed him off.

If possible, he would dedicate a huge chunk of his time just to go after slave traders. They were like a reminder of the torturous past he had endured, and he wasn’t going to tolerate any of that bullshit anymore.
"So, you want to go after them?" Kent asked, and Saden nodded.
Kent turned to Uncle Drew.
"Would you be joining her?"
"No. This is her mission, so she will be going alone. Of course, whenever she needs my help, I will be there, but for now, I will stay and help the master handle the matter of the next Night Rider."
"I see." Kent nodded, and then he snapped his finger.
Gaia appeared instantly, startling Saden and Uncle Drew.

"Gaia, I want you to take Saden to the Tower Store and let her buy everything she needs. You can deduct the cost from my Tower Points but don’t do anything unruly...I will know if you do and punish you."
Gaia nodded with a smile. Obviously, Kent would soon be declaring bankruptcy.

"This is Gaia. She is one of my assistants. Go with her and buy everything you need. Since you want to bring down the entire Malric Noble Family, then it can only be done right." Kent paused and then snapped his finger again.
Nyxira, Kael, and Kaelion appeared, startling the two Night Riders again.

"Saden, this is Nyxira. She is an assassin and a very good one. These are Kael and Kaelion; they are swordsmen. They will be helping you on this mission...Treat them as allies, and watch each other’s backs."
Saden nodded, and the three Soul Sentinels also nodded.
"Gaia, take them all to the store and prepare them well."
The overly cheerful Cosmic Loli nodded and vanished back into the tower with the four. Kent wanted nothing more than to see the fall of the Malrics.
His hatred for slavery is something he will never forget, so using that hatred, he will exact revenge on all of them, despite his trauma happening long before this world even formed.
"What do you plan on doing for now, Uncle Drew?" Kent asked. Though he said he would be staying with him, he knew Drew wouldn’t just sit there all day doing nothing.
"I will first go and check on Eryndor and see how far he has come in the mission you have given him. After that, I will go and check on Saden’s mission, but from a distance.
I will be done before the auction, so I will come to pick you and your ladies up since I presume you will be going."
"Yes, and make room for a few more ladies. My inner circle has widened over the past few weeks," Kent said, and Uncle Drew just smiled.

When they first met, he was driving Kent and Unity to Caprath City. Back then, along the way, Kent and Unity got freaky, but Uncle Drew, instead of getting mad, parked to let them have all the sex they wanted before continuing.
Since then, their bond formed and began to strengthen, so when he was at death’s door, Kent didn’t hesitate to consider using one of his last two remaining wishes to save him.
Luckily, that didn’t happen, and now they are much more connected than before.
But Uncle Drew also knows his young master is a pervert who loves the ladies, so when Kent asked for extra room, he knew anyone who would ride in that carriage would soon be in his bed.
"Don’t worry, young master. The carriage has all the space to accommodate you and your ladies."
"Thank you."
They chatted for a few hours, with Kent learning about Saden now having three subordinates hidden away inside the Realm of the Night.

When Kent heard the Realm of the Night mentioned by Uncle Drew, he felt happy for unknown reasons. He even offered to help him activate his mark, but Kent declined, saying he was not ready to enter that place.
When they were done, Uncle Drew left to go see Eryndor, previously known as Hyx, one of the leaders of the Dark Devil Church on the Human continent.
His mission, after becoming a Night Rider, was to gather all there is to know about the other leaders and the Dark Devil Church as a whole.
It was a dangerous mission, but as a Night Rider, during the night, he is practically invincible.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Quest Completed, Fourth Quest
paragraphs: When Uncle Drew left to check on Eryndor’s progress, Kent decided to rest for a couple of hours. When he woke up, he immediately accessed his rewards from the Third Quest.
It was the chained quest he received when he met the Spear Saintess. It was also the chain quest that kept prompting him on where he should go next and what to do.
Now, he was halfway there.
The third quest was a success. The Spear Saintess had her enlightenment; now, she was just a step away from becoming a Spear Sage.
Of course, that plan would be put on hold for now. The quest reward is just too enticing to be put aside.

Kent had received some rewards that would break her streak and halt her progress—for the better. Once she is done, everything about her will change, making her a powerhouse that will one day rise to the peak of power.
He checked the rewards.
⟪Congratulations on completing the third quest In the ’Become Friends With Spear Saintess Neomi’ Chain quest. Rewards received ⟫
⟪ Rewards: Received ⟫
→ 500,000 Tower Points
→ +10% to Friendship Meter
→ One Time Tower Store Pass
⟪ Additional Rewards: ⟫
→ The 4th Primordial Path of the Spear (Neomi)
→ The Secret Manual of the Voidlings (Ingrid)
"Nice one," Kent smiled, reading through the rewards.
He had already sent four subordinates to the Tower Store to buy what they would need to handle the slave traders. But it seemed he wasn’t in any way broke.
The Tower points from the first, second, and third quests were enough to keep him going. In fact, he was now rich in Tower points.
But until Saden and the three Soul Sentinels left the Tower Store, he wouldn’t be happy just yet.
"Looks like she trusts me even more. I guess whatever went on in the Enlightenment made her put all her hopes and dreams on me... Just as I wanted it.
Lol."
⟦Friendship Meter: 85/100% ⟧
He checked the friendship meter, and to his shock, instead of 70%, it was now 85%. This means that somehow, she had added 15% to it, which wasn’t something he had expected, but it was here now.
"I should probably go see her soon. Who knows? I might get lucky and have a master and her disciple at the same time."
He may have been a slave in his past life, but he is living the life now, and that’s all that matters.
"The additional rewards are also no joke. If this is the way, then I shall walk it."

Right now, all he knew about the Void Eyes was that they once belonged to a race known as the Voidlings. But from how Vexthra described it, they seemed to be more than that, and now Kent has a way to find out.
However, Ingrid’s name was ingrained into the reward, meaning it was for her alone. But the moment she becomes his woman, he will be able to see into it.
"Looks like the way forward is the right one... I must make them smile and moan from pleasure."
After forming all kinds of shameless plans in his head, he started to ponder the best way to find out who the mysterious Nara was—
The quest to find the next Night Rider requires him to find whoever this mysterious Nara is. This means he must do some good old-fashioned detective work.
"I will check the sect records first, and then I will just ask the Spear Saintess to see if she knows something, that’s if I don’t find anything in the sect records.
But first, I must research; who knows what I might find," Kent made his plan.
"Tsk..I am even forgetting Ingrid is a nerd. I will just ask her and see what she knows."
He stood up and was about to freshen up when a fourth quest suddenly appeared.
⟪ Fourth Chain Quest: Become Friends With Spear Saintess Neomi ⟫
⟪ Quest Difficulty: Depends ⟫
-> You manage to earn the Spear Saintess trust...
-> The only thing left is to thrust and ensure she understands that something else is worth dying for aside from the spear.
-> Of course, it is only right to dominate. So why don’t you make it a master and disciple moment? It could be fun.
-> You are the Primordial Chaos Dragon...so show your might.
⟪Rewards: ⟫
→ 1,000,000 Tower Points
→ Dungeon Master Token
→ Universe Wish Token
⟪Additional Rewards: ⟫
→ Voidling Blood Essense
→ Path of The Void
Kent stared at the messages with a smile playing on his lips.
"The universe sure knows how to spoil a guy," he muttered shamelessly. The proposal presented was something he wouldn’t turn down.
It was like being offered rewards for breathing. No matter the outcome of the quests he had received up to this point, he wasn’t about to back down.
Since it all worked out in the end, he could only smile and take it as it should be. Now, all that was required of him was to handle both the master and her disciple at the same time.
He had already handled Unity and Lilian, which was when he was still weak. Now, he was more than ready to go the extra mile.
Kent was ecstatic, so he freshened up and left the Sword Gate. Right now, his objectives were to get stronger, find out who Nara was, and handle both the master and her disciple.
Since Unity and the rest of his ladies were now handling Alina’s mental state, he could only focus on handling things to the best of his abilities.
He arrived at the Spear Gate, but before he could enter, he was stopped by a group of disciples led by Randy. The expression on his face said it all: he was very angry.

Well, he was beaten black and blue by him just a couple of days ago, so in a way, he is beyond pissed. He is a noble heir who prided himself on being strong, but after the humiliations he had been through recently...
Killing Kent is something he would enjoy very much. If possible, he wants to challenge him again, but something tells him he will lose again.
So he can only do what arrogant heirs do best...being arrogant.
"The Spear Gate is off-limits to Sword Gate disciples," Maxwell said, looking smug. He is one of Randy’s minions.
"I know, but do you have the strength to stop me?" Kent asked, looking coldly at him while a mocking smile played on his lips.
"I’m not going to say it again; the Spear Gate is off-limits to Sword Gate disciples. Turn around and leave before we make you."
Maxwell said, pulling a spear from his space ring. The disciples behind him did the same, with only Randy and a few others standing still, not attempting to take out their weapons.
"I don’t have time for your nonsense today, so until we meet next time," Kent said, waving at Randy. The next second, he was 4 km away, leaving the disciples to wonder what had just happened.
Obviously, Kent, who had been inside the Spear Gate before, knew where to go. So he used the [Blink] skill and blinked away, leaving them stunned, and for a moment, they could only grit their teeth.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: The Four Arm Lady
paragraphs: Kent left the confused Randy and his minions at the gate while he made his way toward the Saintess Mansion.
They just didn’t understand what had happened, but they knew their chances of preventing him from entering the Spear Gate would never work in this life or the next.
They had lost, and as it stood, there was no recovering from that.
Kent didn’t care about any of that.
His focus was on what to do about the master and disciple
All of these were urgent, so he planned to get them, as well as his training and uncover who this mysterious Nara was. finish them well, starting with the master and disciple duo.
Right now, he didn’t even have to cultivate. His ladies were the ones doing that. All he had to do was have sex with them, and he would become stronger.
In a way, he had nothing to worry about, provided he had time to spend with his ladies. And that was the thing—he had all the time in the world.
Inside the tower, he had all the time in the world.
So he didn’t care when or how many rounds they wanted; provided he had the stamina, he would get things done.
On his way to the mansion, he sensed the gaze of the Spear Gate master locked on him the entire way until he entered the formation, protecting the mansion from prying eyes.
Kent could only sigh. It seems both the Sword and Spear gate masters have some interest in him, but he wasn’t sure of it at the moment...
"Kent, you are here," Ingrid was the first to see Kent. She was standing with her master and another lady with red skin and four arms. She looked seductive, but Kent could tell she was dangerous.
Kent waved at Ingrid, but at the same time, the Saintess and the red-skinned lady turned toward him. For a moment, Kent’s heart skipped a beat.
The Saintess, though beautiful, had become very dangerous now. Just looking into those beautiful eyes told him what had to be done.
In a way, Kent’s dick started to rise just from looking at Saintess Neomi.
’Damn, does this mean I have a thing for dangerous women?’ he wondered, glancing at the gorgeous lady staring at him.
He then steeled himself and looked at the four-arm lady.

⟪A weapon spirit. This lady is very lucky, and in a way, also very dangerous.⟫ Akira, who was filling in for Gaia, who was busy with Saden and the three soul sentinels—said, making Kent raise an eyebrow.
’A weapon spirit? What is that?’ he asked.

A weapon spirit is basically the spirit of someone who once walked the path of a weapon, like a sword or a spear, but when they died, their spirit was, in a way, given to the Dao, making them dead but in a way alive.

If, through enlightenment, you manage to contract with one, you would not only have access to their skill set, but you will also, in a way, have a weapon that can think. And let me tell you, that is a dangerous thing to have.
